witnesses.separates: The bar lengths skip 2. The concept stacks the bars with no gap row. $RowByLength sets each bar at width minus length rows above the bottom, which leaves an empty row under the 1-cell bar.
Row 0 holds two bars, 2 2 and 3. The concept moves each bar to its own row by length. $RowUnit moves the row as one unit of 3 cells and packs it to the right.
The 8 bar on the bottom row is shorter than the 2 bar. The concept puts the longest bar, 2, on the bottom row. $BaseStays keeps the 8 bar on the bottom row and stacks the other bars on it.
